analysis: Trial completed successfully but the asymmetric scorer did not improve validation: pinned-host macro HR@10 was 0.5425, down 0.0075 from 0.5500 and 0.0312 from the reported best 0.5737. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.5800, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.6000, Electronics 0.3950, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.5950. Electronics remained the weakest category. The result does not support this rank-16 compatibility transformation under the current training setup; metrics alone cannot establish why it regressed. Allocated GPU time was 593.17 seconds. No test metrics were available.
code_summary: Trains one independent GRURec model per category and loads exactly one checkpoint for each prediction route. Shared item embeddings feed a two-layer GRU with causal attention, learned relative-distance bias, projection, and a gated item-embedding residual. The experimental scorer applies normalize(features + (features @ U) @ V.T / sqrt(16)), then scaled cosine similarity with shared candidate embeddings plus learned item bias. U is randomly initialized and V starts at zero to preserve initial cosine scores. Training retains 64-negative BPR-max, two-pass R-Drop, two-step auxiliary supervision, AdamW, seed 42, and validation checkpoint selection. Predictor reconstruction strictly loads both compatibility parameters; runtime checks cover initial equivalence, finite gradients, causality, and reload parity.
